bio.text: David Tangipa is a Republican who represents California's 8th Assembly District; Capitol Weekly described him in March 2025 as a freshman legislator and, at 29, the youngest member of the Legislature.
He grew up in Sacramento, attended Fresno State where he played tight end, then worked in real estate and as a field representative for Fresno County Supervisor Nathan Magsig.
He won the open 8th District seat in 2024. According to Spectrum News, he was raised by an immigrant mother from Tonga and a disabled veteran father.
